name: unidpp-worker
description: UniDPP on Cloudflare Workers: the estate's union surface native to the edge (REARCH R12), TypeScript with the Rust core as WASM

scripts.build:wasm: cargo build --manifest-path wasm/core/Cargo.toml --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release && cp wasm/core/target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/unidpp_core_wasm.wasm src/core_bg.wasm
